-- [Protected by uzbek protect]
-- Uzbek Protect loader. The service checks the key and device credential before delivering a protected release.
local env = getgenv()
-- Fixed service address: a global override would let any other script redirect the key and the loaded code.
local BASE = "https://uzbek-hub-protection.bountyxxxddd.workers.dev"
local PROJECT = "default"
local STATE_KEY = PROJECT == "default" and "uzbek_protect_loader" or "uzbek_protect_loader_" .. PROJECT
local UZP_NO_VIRTUALIZE = function(fn) return fn end
local KEY_FILE = "uzbek_hub/script_key" .. (PROJECT == "default" and "" or "_" .. PROJECT) .. ".txt"
local DEVICE_FILE = "uzbek_hub/device_session" .. (PROJECT == "default" and "" or "_" .. PROJECT) .. ".json"
local DEAD_CREDENTIAL = {DEVICE_DENIED = true, SESSION_EXPIRED = true, SESSION_REQUIRED = true, KEY_EXPIRED = true}
-- A run session that the service ended (key expired or revoked, or another launch took the key over) never recovers.
local DEAD_RUN = {SESSION_ENDED = true, SESSION_EXPIRED = true, SESSION_REQUIRED = true, KEY_EXPIRED = true, KEY_REVOKED = true, DEVICE_DENIED = true, PROJECT_DENIED = true, SCRIPT_DISABLED = true}
local http = request or http_request or (syn and syn.request) or (fluxus and fluxus.request) or (http and http.request)
local http_service = game:GetService("HttpService")
-- Mobile and external executors may expose no hardware-id global; the Roblox client id is stable per install.
local hwid_sources = {}
if type(gethwid) == "function" then hwid_sources[#hwid_sources + 1] = gethwid end
if type(get_hwid) == "function" then hwid_sources[#hwid_sources + 1] = get_hwid end
if type(gethardwareid) == "function" then hwid_sources[#hwid_sources + 1] = gethardwareid end
hwid_sources[#hwid_sources + 1] = function()
	return game:GetService("RbxAnalyticsService"):GetClientId()
end
local function get_hwid()
	for _, source in ipairs(hwid_sources) do
		local ok, value = pcall(source)
		if ok and type(value) == "string" and #value >= 3 and #value <= 512 then return value end
	end
end
local local_player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local username = local_player and local_player.Name
local function fail(message)
    warn("[Uzbek Protect] " .. message)
end
local executor_name = "unknown"
do
    local identify = identifyexecutor or getexecutor
    if type(identify) == "function" then
        local ok, value = pcall(identify)
        if ok and type(value) == "string" and value ~= "" then executor_name = value end
    end
end
if env[STATE_KEY] and env[STATE_KEY].loading then return fail("A script launch is already in progress.") end
if env[STATE_KEY] and env[STATE_KEY].cleanup then pcall(env[STATE_KEY].cleanup) end
local state = {loading = false, connections = {}}
env[STATE_KEY] = state
function state.close_ui()
    for _, connection in ipairs(state.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
    table.clear(state.connections)
    if state.gui then state.gui:Destroy(); state.gui = nil end
end
function state.cleanup()
    if state.session then state.session.stop("Protected session stopped."); state.session = nil end
    state.close_ui()
    if env[STATE_KEY] == state then env[STATE_KEY] = nil end
end
local function launched()
    state.close_ui()
    if not state.session and env[STATE_KEY] == state then env[STATE_KEY] = nil end
end
if type(http) ~= "function" or type(get_hwid) ~= "function" then
    return fail("This executor must support HTTP requests and a hardware identifier (" .. executor_name .. ").")
end
local function post(path, body, bearer)
    local headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" }
    if bearer then headers.Authorization = "Bearer " .. bearer end
    -- Roblox encodes an empty table as [], while these endpoints require a JSON object.
    local encoded = next(body) == nil and "{}" or http_service:JSONEncode(body)
    local ok, response = pcall(http, {Url = BASE .. path, Method = "POST", Headers = headers, Body = encoded})
    if not ok or type(response) ~= "table" then return nil, "Network request failed." end
    if response.StatusCode ~= 200 or type(response.Body) ~= "string" then
        local decoded, value = pcall(http_service.JSONDecode, http_service, response.Body or "")
        return nil, decoded and type(value) == "table" and value.error or "Service unavailable."
    end
    return response.Body
end
-- Run session of a game with server-side logic. The hub gets this one function; the signed token and the sealed
-- server state stay in this closure, where no other script can read them.
-- Game logic and the hub's licence ping use separate sealed states (channel "game" and "ping"); the token is bound to this device.
local function make_brain(run, device, context)
    local token, dead, blobs = run, nil, {}
    return function(input, ping)
        if dead then return nil, dead end
        local channel = ping == "webhook" and "webhook" or (ping and "ping" or "game")
        local response, message = post("/v1/step", {token = token, state = blobs[channel] or "", input = input, channel = channel, hwid = device, username = username, project = PROJECT})
        if not response then
            if DEAD_RUN[message] then dead = message end
            return nil, message
        end
        local parsed, result = pcall(http_service.JSONDecode, http_service, response)
        if not parsed or type(result) ~= "table" or type(result.d) ~= "table" then return nil, "Invalid service answer." end
        if type(result.s) == "string" then blobs[channel] = result.s end
        if type(result.token) == "string" then token = result.token end
        if context and type(result.proof) == "string" then context.proof = result.proof end
        return result.d
    end
end
local function authenticate(credential, restoring)
    if type(credential) ~= "string" then return false, "No saved device session." end
    if not restoring and (not credential:match("^[a-f0-9]+$") or #credential ~= 64) then return false, "Enter your 64-character key." end
    local ok, hwid = pcall(get_hwid)
    if not ok or type(hwid) ~= "string" or #hwid < 3 or #hwid > 512 then return false, "Hardware identifier unavailable (" .. executor_name .. ")." end
    local payload = {hwid = hwid, username = username, universe = tostring(game.GameId), project = PROJECT}
    if restoring then payload.device_token = credential else payload.key = credential end
    local response, message = post(restoring and "/v1/restore" or "/v1/launch", payload)
    payload.hwid = nil
    if not response then return false, message end
    local parsed, manifest = pcall(http_service.JSONDecode, http_service, response)
    if not parsed or type(manifest) ~= "table" or type(manifest.expires) ~= "number" or type(manifest.artifacts) ~= "table" or type(manifest.artifacts.hub) ~= "string" then return false, "Invalid release manifest." end
    local game_entry = ("games/%d.lua"):format(game.GameId)
    if manifest.artifacts[game_entry] ~= nil and type(manifest.artifacts[game_entry]) ~= "string" then return false, "Invalid game entry ticket." end
    local selected = manifest.mode ~= "standalone" and manifest.artifacts[game_entry] and game_entry or "hub"
    local body, artifact_error = post("/v1/artifact", {}, manifest.artifacts[selected])
    if not body then return false, artifact_error end
    local chunk = loadstring(body, "=uzbek_protected")
    body = nil
    if not chunk then return false, "The protected script failed to compile." end
    -- Parts use only tickets from this release and selected application, never arbitrary URLs.
    local prefix = "modules/" .. (selected == "hub" and "universal" or tostring(game.GameId)) .. "/"
    local fetched = {}
    local function fetch(path)
        if path ~= prefix .. "linoria.lua" and path ~= prefix .. "features-1.lua" and path ~= prefix .. "features-2.lua" then return nil end
        if fetched[path] then error("Protected module was already fetched.", 0) end
        local ticket = manifest.artifacts[path]
        if type(ticket) ~= "string" then return nil end
        fetched[path] = true
        local part, problem = post("/v1/artifact", {}, ticket)
        if not part then error(problem or "Protected module unavailable.", 0) end
        return part
    end
    local context
    if type(manifest.run) == "string" or manifest.mode == "standalone" then
        if type(manifest.run) ~= "string" or not task or type(task.spawn) ~= "function" or type(task.wait) ~= "function" or type(task.cancel) ~= "function" then
            return false, "Protected sessions require a run token and task scheduling."
        end
        local active, reason, callbacks = true, nil, {}
        local proof_checks = {}
        local clock = tick or os.clock
        local last_success = clock()
        local heartbeat_interval = manifest.mode == "standalone" and 30 or 15
        local outage_grace = manifest.mode == "standalone" and 240 or 45
        local workers, cleaning = {}, {}
        local function cancel(thread)
            if thread and thread ~= coroutine.running() then pcall(task.cancel, thread) end
        end
        local function cleanup(callback)
            task.spawn(function()
                local thread = coroutine.running()
                cleaning[thread] = true
                pcall(callback, reason)
                cleaning[thread] = nil
            end)
        end
        context = {
            is_active = UZP_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() return active end),
            on_stop = function(callback)
                if type(callback) ~= "function" then error("Stop callback must be a function.") end
                if not active then cleanup(callback) else table.insert(callbacks, callback) end
            end,
            check = function() if not active and not cleaning[coroutine.running()] then error(reason or "Protected session stopped.", 2) end end,
            proof = type(manifest.proof) == "string" and manifest.proof or nil,
            proof_nonce = manifest.proof_nonce,
            on_proof = function(callback)
                if type(callback) ~= "function" then error("Proof callback must be a function.") end
                if not active then error("Protected session stopped.", 0) end
                table.insert(proof_checks, callback)
            end,
            stop = function(message)
                if not active then return end
                active, reason = false, message or "Protected session stopped."
                state.loading = false
                for _, thread in ipairs(workers) do cancel(thread) end
                for _, callback in ipairs(callbacks) do cleanup(callback) end
                table.clear(callbacks)
                table.clear(proof_checks)
            end,
        }
        state.session = context
        local ping_brain = make_brain(manifest.run, hwid, context)
        local watchdog = task.spawn(function()
            while active do
                task.wait(5)
                if not active then break end
                for _, check_proof in ipairs(proof_checks) do
                    if not pcall(check_proof) then context.stop("Protected session proof required."); break end
                end
                if active and clock() - last_success > outage_grace then context.stop("Protected session is unreachable.") end
            end
        end)
        if active then table.insert(workers, watchdog) else cancel(watchdog) end
        local heartbeat = task.spawn(function()
            while active do
                task.wait(heartbeat_interval)
                if not active then break end
                local ok, result, message = pcall(ping_brain, {}, true)
                if not active then break end
                if ok and type(result) == "table" and result.ok == true then last_success = clock()
                elseif ok and DEAD_RUN[message] then context.stop(message) end
            end
        end)
        if active then table.insert(workers, heartbeat) else cancel(heartbeat) end
    end
    local previous_hubs = env.uzbek_hubs
    local previous_hub = type(previous_hubs) == "table" and previous_hubs[PROJECT] or nil
    if PROJECT == "default" and previous_hub == nil then previous_hub = env.uzbek_hub end
    local catalog={selected=selected,artifacts=type(manifest.catalog_keys)=="table" and manifest.catalog_keys or {},unlock=function() error("Protected key unavailable",0) end}
    local ran, result = pcall(chunk, fetch, type(manifest.run) == "string" and make_brain(manifest.run, hwid, context) or nil, context, PROJECT, catalog)
    local hubs = env.uzbek_hubs
    local hub
    if type(hubs) == "table" then hub = hubs[PROJECT] end
    if PROJECT == "default" and hub == nil then hub = env.uzbek_hub end
    if context and type(hub) == "table" then
        local owned = hub
        context.on_stop(function()
            if type(owned) == "table" and type(owned.detach) == "function" then pcall(owned.detach) end
        end)
        if not context.is_active() then
            if type(owned.detach) == "function" then pcall(owned.detach) end
            return false, "Protected session stopped during launch."
        end
    end
    if not ran or (manifest.mode ~= "standalone" and (type(hub) ~= "table" or hub == previous_hub)) then
        if hub ~= previous_hub and type(hub) == "table" and type(hub.detach) == "function" then pcall(hub.detach) end
        if context then context.stop("The protected script failed to initialize.") end
        if not ran then fail(tostring(result)) end
        return false, "The protected hub failed to initialize."
    end
    local device_token = restoring and credential or manifest.device_token
    if type(device_token) == "string" and isfolder and makefolder and writefile then
        local saved = pcall(function()
            if not isfolder("uzbek_hub") then makefolder("uzbek_hub") end
            writefile(DEVICE_FILE, http_service:JSONEncode({device_token = device_token, expires = manifest.expires}))
        end)
        -- Retire the legacy raw-key file only after the replacement credential was saved.
        if saved and isfile and delfile and isfile(KEY_FILE) then pcall(delfile, KEY_FILE) end
    end
    return true, result
end
local function start(credential, restoring)
    if state.loading then return false, "A hub launch is already in progress." end
    state.loading = true
    local ran, ok, message = pcall(authenticate, credential, restoring)
    state.loading = false
    if not ran then return false, "The protection service is unavailable." end
    return ok, message
end
if readfile then
    local read, data = pcall(readfile, DEVICE_FILE)
    if read then
        local decoded, saved = pcall(http_service.JSONDecode, http_service, data)
        if decoded and type(saved) == "table" and type(saved.device_token) == "string" then
            local ok, message = start(saved.device_token, true)
            if ok then launched(); return end
            -- A denied or expired credential never recovers; network failures keep the file.
            if DEAD_CREDENTIAL[message] and delfile then pcall(delfile, DEVICE_FILE) end
            fail(tostring(message))
        end
    end
end
local key = PROJECT == "default" and env.script_key or (type(env.uzbek_script_keys) == "table" and env.uzbek_script_keys[PROJECT])
if type(key) ~= "string" and readfile then
    local ok, saved = pcall(readfile, KEY_FILE)
    if ok then key = saved:gsub("%s", "") end
end
if type(key) == "string" then
    local ok, message = start(key)
    if ok then launched(); return end
    fail(message)
end
local players = game:GetService("Players")
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "UzbekProtectKey"
state.gui = gui
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
local protected = gethui and gethui()
gui.Parent = protected or players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 220)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0.5, -110)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 20, 26)
frame.Parent = gui
local function label(text, y, class)
    local item = Instance.new(class or "TextLabel")
    item.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 32)
    item.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, y)
    item.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(9, 11, 16)
    item.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(232, 238, 248)
    item.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
    item.TextSize = 17
    item.Text = text
    item.Parent = frame
    return item
end
label("Uzbek Hub · Advertising key", 12)
local input = label("", 52, "TextBox")
input.PlaceholderText = "Paste your key"
input.ClearTextOnFocus = false
local unlock = label("Unlock", 92, "TextButton")
unlock.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 148, 242)
local get_key = label("Copy key page link", 132, "TextButton")
local status = label("One task · 12 hours", 172)
local busy = false
local unlock_connection, link_connection
unlock_connection = unlock.Activated:Connect(function()
    if busy then return end
    busy = true
    status.Text = "Checking key…"
    -- Parentheses keep only the string: gsub's second result would otherwise become the `restoring` flag.
    local ok, message = start((input.Text:gsub("%s", "")))
    if ok then
        launched()
    else status.Text = tostring(message); busy = false end
end)
link_connection = get_key.Activated:Connect(function()
    if setclipboard then setclipboard(BASE .. "/get-key"); status.Text = "Key page link copied."
    else status.Text = BASE .. "/get-key" end
end)
state.connections = {unlock_connection, link_connection}

local math,string,table,bit32,type,error,pcall,xpcall,pairs,ipairs,tostring,setmetatable,select,tonumber=table.freeze(table.clone(math)),table.freeze(table.clone(string)),table.freeze(table.clone(table)),table.freeze(table.clone(bit32)),type,error,pcall,xpcall,pairs,ipairs,tostring,setmetatable,select,tonumber

local environment=setmetatable({}, {__index=function(_,name)local get=bindings[2][name];if not get then error("invalid V3 global reference",0) end;return get() end,__newindex=function(_,name,value)local set=bindings[3][name];if not set then error("invalid V3 global assignment",0) end;set(value) end})
local bxor, band, rol = bit32.bxor, bit32.band, bit32.lrotate
local function uint32(s, p)
    local a,b,c,d=string.byte(s,p,p+3)
    if not d then error("invalid protected data",0) end
    return a+b*256+c*65536+d*16777216
end
local function bytes32(n)
    return string.char(n%256,math.floor(n/256)%256,math.floor(n/65536)%256,math.floor(n/16777216)%256)
end
local function crypt(data,key,nonce)
    local initial={1634760805,857760878,2036477234,1797285236}
    for i=1,8 do initial[i+4]=uint32(key,(i-1)*4+1) end
    initial[13]=1
    for i=1,3 do initial[i+13]=uint32(nonce,(i-1)*4+1) end
    local out={}
    local x
    local function quarter(a,b,c,d)
        x[a]=(x[a]+x[b])%4294967296; x[d]=rol(bxor(x[d],x[a]),16)
        x[c]=(x[c]+x[d])%4294967296; x[b]=rol(bxor(x[b],x[c]),12)
        x[a]=(x[a]+x[b])%4294967296; x[d]=rol(bxor(x[d],x[a]),8)
        x[c]=(x[c]+x[d])%4294967296; x[b]=rol(bxor(x[b],x[c]),7)
    end
    for offset=1,#data,64 do
        x=table.clone(initial)
        for _=1,10 do
            quarter(1,5,9,13);quarter(2,6,10,14);quarter(3,7,11,15);quarter(4,8,12,16)
            quarter(1,6,11,16);quarter(2,7,12,13);quarter(3,8,9,14);quarter(4,5,10,15)
        end
        local block={};for i=1,16 do block[i]=bytes32((x[i]+initial[i])%4294967296) end
        local stream=table.concat(block);local chunk={}
        for i=0,math.min(63,#data-offset) do chunk[i+1]=string.char(bxor(string.byte(data,offset+i),string.byte(stream,i+1))) end
        out[#out+1]=table.concat(chunk);initial[13]=(initial[13]+1)%4294967296
        if initial[13]==0 then error("protected data too large",0) end
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end
local function decode(s)
    local pos,budget=1,0
    local function uint()
        local n,m=0,1
        for _=1,5 do
            local b=string.byte(s,pos);pos+=1
            if not b then error("truncated protected data",0) end
            n+=(b%128)*m
            if b<128 then return n end
            m*=128
        end
        error("invalid protected length",0)
    end
    local read
    read=function(depth)
        budget+=1;if depth>256 or budget>4000000 then error("protected format limit",0) end
        local tag=string.byte(s,pos);pos+=1
        if tag==0 then return nil elseif tag==1 then return false elseif tag==2 then return true
        elseif tag==6 then return uint()
        elseif tag==3 then
            local lo,hi=uint32(s,pos),uint32(s,pos+4);pos+=8
            local sign=hi>=2147483648 and -1 or 1
            local exponent=math.floor(hi/1048576)%2048
            local mantissa=(hi%1048576)*4294967296+lo
            if exponent==0 then return sign*mantissa*2^-1074 end
            if exponent==2047 then return mantissa==0 and sign*math.huge or 0/0 end
            return sign*(1+mantissa/4503599627370496)*2^(exponent-1023)
        elseif tag==4 then
            local n=uint();if n>#s-pos+1 then error("truncated protected string",0) end
            local value=string.sub(s,pos,pos+n-1);pos+=n;return value
        elseif tag==5 then
            local n=uint();if n>4000000 or n>#s-pos+1 then error("invalid protected array",0) end
            local result={};for i=1,n do result[i]=read(depth+1) end;return result
        end
        error("invalid protected value",0)
    end
    local result=read(0)
    if pos~=#s+1 then error("extra protected data",0) end
    return result
end
local __uzp_key_arg=select(5,...)
local __uzp_entry=type(__uzp_key_arg)=="table" and type(__uzp_key_arg.selected)=="string" and type(__uzp_key_arg.artifacts)=="table" and __uzp_key_arg.artifacts[__uzp_key_arg.selected] or nil
local __uzp_unlock=type(__uzp_key_arg)=="table" and type(__uzp_key_arg.unlock)=="function" and __uzp_key_arg.unlock or nil
local function __uzp_hex(value,label)
 if type(value)~="string" or #value~=64 or value:find("[^%x]") then error(label,0) end
 return (value:gsub("%x%x",function(h)return string.char(tonumber(h,16))end))
end
local function __uzp_catalog_key()
 if type(__uzp_entry)~="table" then error("Protected catalog key unavailable",0) end
 return __uzp_hex(__uzp_entry.catalog,"Protected catalog key unavailable")
end
local function __uzp_proto_key(proto)
 local keys=type(__uzp_entry)=="table" and __uzp_entry.keys or nil
 local value=type(keys)=="table" and (keys[proto] or keys[tostring(proto)]) or nil
 if not value and __uzp_unlock then value=__uzp_unlock(proto) end
 return __uzp_hex(value,"Protected prototype key unavailable")
end
local iscclosure,debugInfo=iscclosure,debug and debug.info
local runtimeFunctions={loadstring=loadstring,setfenv=setfenv,getfenv=getfenv,pcall=pcall,xpcall=xpcall,type=type,error=error,pairs=pairs,ipairs=ipairs,tostring=tostring,setmetatable=setmetatable,debugInfo=debugInfo}
local function verifyRuntime()
    if type(iscclosure)~="function" then return end
    for name,fn in pairs(runtimeFunctions) do
        if type(fn)~="function" or not iscclosure(fn) then error("invalid V3 runtime integrity: "..name,0) end
    end
end

local __rsa=(function()
-- Pure-Luau RSA-2048 PKCS#1 v1.5 SHA-256 verification (bit32 only).
local bit32 = bit32
local band, bor, bxor, rshift, lshift = bit32.band, bit32.bor, bit32.bxor, bit32.rshift, bit32.lshift
local B = 16777216 -- 2^24

local function sha256(message)
    local K = {
        0x428a2f98,0x71374491,0xb5c0fbcf,0xe9b5dba5,0x3956c25b,0x59f111f1,0x923f82a4,0xab1c5ed5,
        0xd807aa98,0x12835b01,0x243185be,0x550c7dc3,0x72be5d74,0x80deb1fe,0x9bdc06a7,0xc19bf174,
        0xe49b69c1,0xefbe4786,0x0fc19dc6,0x240ca1cc,0x2de92c6f,0x4a7484aa,0x5cb0a9dc,0x76f988da,
        0x983e5152,0xa831c66d,0xb00327c8,0xbf597fc7,0xc6e00bf3,0xd5a79147,0x06ca6351,0x14292967,
        0x27b70a85,0x2e1b2138,0x4d2c6dfc,0x53380d13,0x650a7354,0x766a0abb,0x81c2c92e,0x92722c85,
        0xa2bfe8a1,0xa81a664b,0xc24b8b70,0xc76c51a3,0xd192e819,0xd6990624,0xf40e3585,0x106aa070,
        0x19a4c116,0x1e376c08,0x2748774c,0x34b0bcb5,0x391c0cb3,0x4ed8aa4a,0x5b9cca4f,0x682e6ff3,
        0x748f82ee,0x78a5636f,0x84c87814,0x8cc70208,0x90befffa,0xa4506ceb,0xbef9a3f7,0xc67178f2,
    }
    local h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7 = 0x6a09e667,0xbb67ae85,0x3c6ef372,0xa54ff53a,0x510e527f,0x9b05688c,0x1f83d9ab,0x5be0cd19
    local function ror(x,n) return bor(rshift(x,n), lshift(x, 32-n)) end
    local bytes = { string.byte(message,1,#message) }
    local bitLength = #message * 8
    bytes[#bytes+1] = 0x80
    while #bytes % 64 ~= 56 do bytes[#bytes+1] = 0 end
    local high = math.floor(bitLength / 4294967296)
    for i = 3, 0, -1 do bytes[#bytes+1] = math.floor(high / 256^i) % 256 end
    for i = 3, 0, -1 do bytes[#bytes+1] = math.floor(bitLength / 256^i) % 256 end
    for chunk = 1, #bytes, 64 do
        local w = {}
        for i = 0, 15 do
            local o = chunk + i * 4
            w[i] = bytes[o]*16777216 + bytes[o+1]*65536 + bytes[o+2]*256 + bytes[o+3]
        end
        for i = 16, 63 do
            local s0 = bxor(ror(w[i-15],7), ror(w[i-15],18), rshift(w[i-15],3))
            local s1 = bxor(ror(w[i-2],17), ror(w[i-2],19), rshift(w[i-2],10))
            w[i] = (w[i-16] + s0 + w[i-7] + s1) % 4294967296
        end
        local a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h = h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7
        for i = 0, 63 do
            local S1 = bxor(ror(e,6), ror(e,11), ror(e,25))
            local ch = bxor(band(e,f), band(bxor(e,0xffffffff),g))
            local t1 = (h + S1 + ch + K[i+1] + w[i]) % 4294967296
            local S0 = bxor(ror(a,2), ror(a,13), ror(a,22))
            local maj = bxor(band(a,b), band(a,c), band(b,c))
            local t2 = (S0 + maj) % 4294967296
            h,g,f,e,d,c,b,a = g,f,e,(d+t1)%4294967296,c,b,a,(t1+t2)%4294967296
        end
        h0=(h0+a)%4294967296; h1=(h1+b)%4294967296; h2=(h2+c)%4294967296; h3=(h3+d)%4294967296
        h4=(h4+e)%4294967296; h5=(h5+f)%4294967296; h6=(h6+g)%4294967296; h7=(h7+h)%4294967296
    end
    local out = {}
    for _,v in ipairs({h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7}) do
        out[#out+1]=string.char(math.floor(v/16777216)%256, math.floor(v/65536)%256, math.floor(v/256)%256, v%256)
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end

local function fromBytes(s)
    local limbs, value, shift = {}, 0, 1
    for i = #s, 1, -1 do
        value = value + string.byte(s,i) * shift
        shift = shift * 256
        if shift == B then limbs[#limbs+1] = value; value, shift = 0, 1 end
    end
    if shift > 1 then limbs[#limbs+1] = value end
    while #limbs > 0 and limbs[#limbs] == 0 do limbs[#limbs] = nil end
    return limbs
end

local function toBytes(limbs, length)
    local out = {}
    local count = math.ceil(length / 3)
    for i = 1, count do
        local v = limbs[i] or 0
        out[#out+1] = v % 256
        out[#out+1] = math.floor(v / 256) % 256
        out[#out+1] = math.floor(v / 65536) % 256
    end
    local bytes = {}
    for i = length, 1, -1 do bytes[#bytes+1] = string.char(out[i]) end
    return table.concat(bytes)
end

local function compare(a,b)
    local n = math.max(#a,#b)
    for i = n, 1, -1 do
        local x,y = a[i] or 0, b[i] or 0
        if x ~= y then return x < y and -1 or 1 end
    end
    return 0
end

local function subtract(a,b)
    local out, borrow = {}, 0
    for i = 1, #a do
        local v = (a[i] or 0) - (b[i] or 0) - borrow
        if v < 0 then v = v + B; borrow = 1 else borrow = 0 end
        out[i] = v
    end
    while #out > 0 and out[#out] == 0 do out[#out] = nil end
    return out
end

local function montMul(a,b,n,n0inv,L)
    local t = {}
    for i = 1, 2*L + 1 do t[i] = 0 end
    for i = 1, L do
        local ai = a[i] or 0
        local carry = 0
        for j = 1, L do
            local k = i + j - 1
            local v = t[k] + ai * (b[j] or 0) + carry
            t[k] = v % B
            carry = math.floor(v / B)
        end
        local k = i + L
        while carry > 0 do
            local v = t[k] + carry
            t[k] = v % B
            carry = math.floor(v / B)
            k = k + 1
        end
    end
    for i = 1, L do
        local m = (t[i] * n0inv) % B
        local carry = 0
        for j = 1, L do
            local k = i + j - 1
            local v = t[k] + m * (n[j] or 0) + carry
            t[k] = v % B
            carry = math.floor(v / B)
        end
        local k = i + L
        while carry > 0 do
            local v = t[k] + carry
            t[k] = v % B
            carry = math.floor(v / B)
            k = k + 1
        end
    end
    local r = {}
    for i = 1, L do r[i] = t[L+i] or 0 end
    if (t[2*L+1] or 0) > 0 then r[L+1] = t[2*L+1] end
    if compare(r,n) >= 0 then r = subtract(r,n) end
    while #r > 0 and r[#r] == 0 do r[#r] = nil end
    return r
end

local function powmod(sig, n, n0inv, R2, L)
    local one = {1}
    local base = montMul(sig, R2, n, n0inv, L)
    local r = base
    for _ = 1, 16 do r = montMul(r, r, n, n0inv, L) end
    r = montMul(r, base, n, n0inv, L)
    return montMul(r, one, n, n0inv, L)
end

local function verify(message, signature, n, n0inv, R2, L)
    local s = fromBytes(signature)
    if #s > L then return false end
    if compare(s, n) >= 0 then return false end
    local value = powmod(s, n, n0inv, R2, L)
    local em = toBytes(value, 256)
    local digest = sha256(message)
    local prefix = "\0\1" .. string.rep("\255", 202) .. "\0" .. "\48\49\48\13\6\9\96\134\72\1\101\3\4\2\1\5\0\4\32"
    return em == prefix .. digest
end

local function montOne(n,n0inv,R2,L) return montMul(R2,{1},n,n0inv,L) end

return { verify = verify, sha256 = sha256, powmod = powmod, toBytes = toBytes, fromBytes = fromBytes, montOne = montOne }

end)()

local function __verifyProof(proof)
    if type(proof)~="string" or #proof>800 then return false end
    local exp,device,release,nonce,sig=proof:match("^(%d+):([a-f0-9]+):([%w._-]+):([a-f0-9]+):([a-f0-9]+)$")
    if not exp or #exp>12 or #sig~=512 or #nonce~=64 or device~=__deviceHash or release~="V3-mobile-update-20261031-1" or nonce~=__proofNonce then return false end
    local expires=tonumber(exp)
    if not expires or os.time()>=expires then return false end
    local bytes={}
    for i=1,#sig,2 do bytes[#bytes+1]=string.char(tonumber(string.sub(sig,i,i+1),16)) end
    return __rsa.verify("uzp1|"..exp.."|"..device.."|"..release.."|"..nonce,table.concat(bytes),__n,__n0inv,__R2,__L)
end

__proofContext.on_proof(function()
    local now=os.time()
    if now<__lastProofOk then error("Protected session clock invalid",0) end
    if now-__lastProofOk<60 and now<__proofExpires then return end
    if not __verifyProof(__proofContext.proof) then error("Protected session proof required",0) end
    __lastProofOk=now
    __proofExpires=tonumber(__proofContext.proof:match("^(%d+):"))
end)

local function immutable(value)
    if type(value)~="table" or table.isfrozen(value) then return value end
    for _,child in pairs(value) do if type(child)=="table" then immutable(child) end end
    table.freeze(value)
    if not table.isfrozen(value) then error("invalid V3 antitamper freeze",0) end
    return value
end
local function checked(data,key,nonce,length,expected,raw)
    local plain=crypt(data,key,nonce)
    if #plain~=length then error("invalid V3 section length",0) end
    local a,b=1,0
    for i=1,#plain do a=(a+string.byte(plain,i))%65521;b=(b+a)%65521 end
    if b*65536+a~=expected then error("invalid V3 section checksum",0) end
    if raw then return plain end
    return decode(plain)
end
local alphabet="ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"

local function unbase64(text)
    if #text%4~=0 then error("invalid V3 transport length",0) end
    local result={}
    for i=1,#text,4 do
        local a,b,c,d=string.byte(text,i,i+3)
        local x,y,z,w=base64codes[a],base64codes[b],base64codes[c],base64codes[d]
        if not x or not y or (not z and c~=61) or (not w and d~=61) then error("invalid V3 transport",0) end
        if (c==61 or d==61) and i+3~=#text then error("invalid V3 transport padding",0) end
        if c==61 and d~=61 then error("invalid V3 transport padding",0) end
        local n=x*262144+y*4096+(z or 0)*64+(w or 0)
        local bytes={string.char(math.floor(n/65536)%256)}
        if c~=61 then bytes[2]=string.char(math.floor(n/256)%256) end
        if d~=61 then bytes[3]=string.char(n%256) end
        result[#result+1]=table.concat(bytes)
    end
    return table.concat(result)
end

local bxor, band, rol = bit32.bxor, bit32.band, bit32.lrotate
local function uint32(s, p)
    local a,b,c,d=string.byte(s,p,p+3)
    if not d then error("invalid protected data",0) end
    return a+b*256+c*65536+d*16777216
end
local function bytes32(n)
    return string.char(n%256,math.floor(n/256)%256,math.floor(n/65536)%256,math.floor(n/16777216)%256)
end
local function crypt(data,key,nonce)
    local initial={1634760805,857760878,2036477234,1797285236}
    for i=1,8 do initial[i+4]=uint32(key,(i-1)*4+1) end
    initial[13]=1
    for i=1,3 do initial[i+13]=uint32(nonce,(i-1)*4+1) end
    local out={}
    local x
    local function quarter(a,b,c,d)
        x[a]=(x[a]+x[b])%4294967296; x[d]=rol(bxor(x[d],x[a]),16)
        x[c]=(x[c]+x[d])%4294967296; x[b]=rol(bxor(x[b],x[c]),12)
        x[a]=(x[a]+x[b])%4294967296; x[d]=rol(bxor(x[d],x[a]),8)
        x[c]=(x[c]+x[d])%4294967296; x[b]=rol(bxor(x[b],x[c]),7)
    end
    for offset=1,#data,64 do
        x=table.clone(initial)
        for _=1,10 do
            quarter(1,5,9,13);quarter(2,6,10,14);quarter(3,7,11,15);quarter(4,8,12,16)
            quarter(1,6,11,16);quarter(2,7,12,13);quarter(3,8,9,14);quarter(4,5,10,15)
        end
        local block={};for i=1,16 do block[i]=bytes32((x[i]+initial[i])%4294967296) end
        local stream=table.concat(block);local chunk={}
        for i=0,math.min(63,#data-offset) do chunk[i+1]=string.char(bxor(string.byte(data,offset+i),string.byte(stream,i+1))) end
        out[#out+1]=table.concat(chunk);initial[13]=(initial[13]+1)%4294967296
        if initial[13]==0 then error("protected data too large",0) end
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end
local function decode(s)
    local pos,budget=1,0
    local function uint()
        local n,m=0,1
        for _=1,5 do
            local b=string.byte(s,pos);pos+=1
            if not b then error("truncated protected data",0) end
            n+=(b%128)*m
            if b<128 then return n end
            m*=128
        end
        error("invalid protected length",0)
    end
    local read
    read=function(depth)
        budget+=1;if depth>256 or budget>4000000 then error("protected format limit",0) end
        local tag=string.byte(s,pos);pos+=1
        if tag==0 then return nil elseif tag==1 then return false elseif tag==2 then return true
        elseif tag==6 then return uint()
        elseif tag==3 then
            local lo,hi=uint32(s,pos),uint32(s,pos+4);pos+=8
            local sign=hi>=2147483648 and -1 or 1
            local exponent=math.floor(hi/1048576)%2048
            local mantissa=(hi%1048576)*4294967296+lo
            if exponent==0 then return sign*mantissa*2^-1074 end
            if exponent==2047 then return mantissa==0 and sign*math.huge or 0/0 end
            return sign*(1+mantissa/4503599627370496)*2^(exponent-1023)
        elseif tag==4 then
            local n=uint();if n>#s-pos+1 then error("truncated protected string",0) end
            local value=string.sub(s,pos,pos+n-1);pos+=n;return value
        elseif tag==5 then
            local n=uint();if n>4000000 or n>#s-pos+1 then error("invalid protected array",0) end
            local result={};for i=1,n do result[i]=read(depth+1) end;return result
        end
        error("invalid protected value",0)
    end
    local result=read(0)
    if pos~=#s+1 then error("extra protected data",0) end
    return result
end

local function __uzp_hex(value,label)
 if type(value)~="string" or #value~=64 or value:find("[^%x]") then error(label,0) end
 return (value:gsub("%x%x",function(h)return string.char(tonumber(h,16))end))
end
local function __uzp_catalog_key()
 if type(__uzp_entry)~="table" then error("Protected catalog key unavailable",0) end
 return __uzp_hex(__uzp_entry.catalog,"Protected catalog key unavailable")
end
local function __uzp_proto_key(proto)

 if not value and __uzp_unlock then value=__uzp_unlock(proto) end
 return __uzp_hex(value,"Protected prototype key unavailable")
end

local function verifyRuntime()

    for name,fn in pairs(runtimeFunctions) do
        if type(fn)~="function" or not iscclosure(fn) then error("invalid V3 runtime integrity: "..name,0) end
    end
end

local __rsa=(function()
-- Pure-Luau RSA-2048 PKCS#1 v1.5 SHA-256 verification (bit32 only).
local bit32 = bit32
local band, bor, bxor, rshift, lshift = bit32.band, bit32.bor, bit32.bxor, bit32.rshift, bit32.lshift
local B = 16777216 -- 2^24

local function sha256(message)
    local K = {
        0x428a2f98,0x71374491,0xb5c0fbcf,0xe9b5dba5,0x3956c25b,0x59f111f1,0x923f82a4,0xab1c5ed5,
        0xd807aa98,0x12835b01,0x243185be,0x550c7dc3,0x72be5d74,0x80deb1fe,0x9bdc06a7,0xc19bf174,
        0xe49b69c1,0xefbe4786,0x0fc19dc6,0x240ca1cc,0x2de92c6f,0x4a7484aa,0x5cb0a9dc,0x76f988da,
        0x983e5152,0xa831c66d,0xb00327c8,0xbf597fc7,0xc6e00bf3,0xd5a79147,0x06ca6351,0x14292967,
        0x27b70a85,0x2e1b2138,0x4d2c6dfc,0x53380d13,0x650a7354,0x766a0abb,0x81c2c92e,0x92722c85,
        0xa2bfe8a1,0xa81a664b,0xc24b8b70,0xc76c51a3,0xd192e819,0xd6990624,0xf40e3585,0x106aa070,
        0x19a4c116,0x1e376c08,0x2748774c,0x34b0bcb5,0x391c0cb3,0x4ed8aa4a,0x5b9cca4f,0x682e6ff3,
        0x748f82ee,0x78a5636f,0x84c87814,0x8cc70208,0x90befffa,0xa4506ceb,0xbef9a3f7,0xc67178f2,
    }
    local h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7 = 0x6a09e667,0xbb67ae85,0x3c6ef372,0xa54ff53a,0x510e527f,0x9b05688c,0x1f83d9ab,0x5be0cd19
    local function ror(x,n) return bor(rshift(x,n), lshift(x, 32-n)) end
    local bytes = { string.byte(message,1,#message) }
    local bitLength = #message * 8
    bytes[#bytes+1] = 0x80
    while #bytes % 64 ~= 56 do bytes[#bytes+1] = 0 end
    local high = math.floor(bitLength / 4294967296)
    for i = 3, 0, -1 do bytes[#bytes+1] = math.floor(high / 256^i) % 256 end
    for i = 3, 0, -1 do bytes[#bytes+1] = math.floor(bitLength / 256^i) % 256 end
    for chunk = 1, #bytes, 64 do
        local w = {}
        for i = 0, 15 do
            local o = chunk + i * 4
            w[i] = bytes[o]*16777216 + bytes[o+1]*65536 + bytes[o+2]*256 + bytes[o+3]
        end
        for i = 16, 63 do
            local s0 = bxor(ror(w[i-15],7), ror(w[i-15],18), rshift(w[i-15],3))
            local s1 = bxor(ror(w[i-2],17), ror(w[i-2],19), rshift(w[i-2],10))
            w[i] = (w[i-16] + s0 + w[i-7] + s1) % 4294967296
        end
        local a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h = h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7
        for i = 0, 63 do
            local S1 = bxor(ror(e,6), ror(e,11), ror(e,25))
            local ch = bxor(band(e,f), band(bxor(e,0xffffffff),g))
            local t1 = (h + S1 + ch + K[i+1] + w[i]) % 4294967296
            local S0 = bxor(ror(a,2), ror(a,13), ror(a,22))
            local maj = bxor(band(a,b), band(a,c), band(b,c))
            local t2 = (S0 + maj) % 4294967296
            h,g,f,e,d,c,b,a = g,f,e,(d+t1)%4294967296,c,b,a,(t1+t2)%4294967296
        end
        h0=(h0+a)%4294967296; h1=(h1+b)%4294967296; h2=(h2+c)%4294967296; h3=(h3+d)%4294967296
        h4=(h4+e)%4294967296; h5=(h5+f)%4294967296; h6=(h6+g)%4294967296; h7=(h7+h)%4294967296
    end
    local out = {}
    for _,v in ipairs({h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7}) do
        out[#out+1]=string.char(math.floor(v/16777216)%256, math.floor(v/65536)%256, math.floor(v/256)%256, v%256)
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end

local function fromBytes(s)
    local limbs, value, shift = {}, 0, 1
    for i = #s, 1, -1 do
        value = value + string.byte(s,i) * shift
        shift = shift * 256
        if shift == B then limbs[#limbs+1] = value; value, shift = 0, 1 end
    end
    if shift > 1 then limbs[#limbs+1] = value end
    while #limbs > 0 and limbs[#limbs] == 0 do limbs[#limbs] = nil end
    return limbs
end

local function toBytes(limbs, length)
    local out = {}
    local count = math.ceil(length / 3)
    for i = 1, count do
        local v = limbs[i] or 0
        out[#out+1] = v % 256
        out[#out+1] = math.floor(v / 256) % 256
        out[#out+1] = math.floor(v / 65536) % 256
    end
    local bytes = {}
    for i = length, 1, -1 do bytes[#bytes+1] = string.char(out[i]) end
    return table.concat(bytes)
end

local function compare(a,b)
    local n = math.max(#a,#b)
    for i = n, 1, -1 do
        local x,y = a[i] or 0, b[i] or 0
        if x ~= y then return x < y and -1 or 1 end
    end
    return 0
end

local function subtract(a,b)
    local out, borrow = {}, 0
    for i = 1, #a do
        local v = (a[i] or 0) - (b[i] or 0) - borrow
        if v < 0 then v = v + B; borrow = 1 else borrow = 0 end
        out[i] = v
    end
    while #out > 0 and out[#out] == 0 do out[#out] = nil end
    return out
end

local function montMul(a,b,n,n0inv,L)
    local t = {}
    for i = 1, 2*L + 1 do t[i] = 0 end
    for i = 1, L do
        local ai = a[i] or 0
        local carry = 0
        for j = 1, L do
            local k = i + j - 1
            local v = t[k] + ai * (b[j] or 0) + carry
            t[k] = v % B
            carry = math.floor(v / B)
        end
        local k = i + L
        while carry > 0 do
            local v = t[k] + carry
            t[k] = v % B
            carry = math.floor(v / B)
            k = k + 1
        end
    end
    for i = 1, L do
        local m = (t[i] * n0inv) % B
        local carry = 0
        for j = 1, L do
            local k = i + j - 1
            local v = t[k] + m * (n[j] or 0) + carry
            t[k] = v % B
            carry = math.floor(v / B)
        end
        local k = i + L
        while carry > 0 do
            local v = t[k] + carry
            t[k] = v % B
            carry = math.floor(v / B)
            k = k + 1
        end
    end
    local r = {}
    for i = 1, L do r[i] = t[L+i] or 0 end
    if (t[2*L+1] or 0) > 0 then r[L+1] = t[2*L+1] end
    if compare(r,n) >= 0 then r = subtract(r,n) end
    while #r > 0 and r[#r] == 0 do r[#r] = nil end
    return r
end

local function powmod(sig, n, n0inv, R2, L)
    local one = {1}
    local base = montMul(sig, R2, n, n0inv, L)
    local r = base
    for _ = 1, 16 do r = montMul(r, r, n, n0inv, L) end
    r = montMul(r, base, n, n0inv, L)
    return montMul(r, one, n, n0inv, L)
end

local function verify(message, signature, n, n0inv, R2, L)
    local s = fromBytes(signature)
    if #s > L then return false end
    if compare(s, n) >= 0 then return false end
    local value = powmod(s, n, n0inv, R2, L)
    local em = toBytes(value, 256)
    local digest = sha256(message)
    local prefix = "\0\1" .. string.rep("\255", 202) .. "\0" .. "\48\49\48\13\6\9\96\134\72\1\101\3\4\2\1\5\0\4\32"
    return em == prefix .. digest
end

local function montOne(n,n0inv,R2,L) return montMul(R2,{1},n,n0inv,L) end

return { verify = verify, sha256 = sha256, powmod = powmod, toBytes = toBytes, fromBytes = fromBytes, montOne = montOne }

local function immutable(value)
    if type(value)~="table" or table.isfrozen(value) then return value end
    for _,child in pairs(value) do if type(child)=="table" then immutable(child) end end
    table.freeze(value)
    if not table.isfrozen(value) then error("invalid V3 antitamper freeze",0) end
    return value
end
local function checked(data,key,nonce,length,expected,raw)
    local plain=crypt(data,key,nonce)
    if #plain~=length then error("invalid V3 section length",0) end
    local a,b=1,0
    for i=1,#plain do a=(a+string.byte(plain,i))%65521;b=(b+a)%65521 end
    if b*65536+a~=expected then error("invalid V3 section checksum",0) end
    if raw then return plain end
    return decode(plain)
end

local function unbase64(text)
    if #text%4~=0 then error("invalid V3 transport length",0) end
    local result={}
    for i=1,#text,4 do
        local a,b,c,d=string.byte(text,i,i+3)
        local x,y,z,w=base64codes[a],base64codes[b],base64codes[c],base64codes[d]
        if not x or not y or (not z and c~=61) or (not w and d~=61) then error("invalid V3 transport",0) end
        if (c==61 or d==61) and i+3~=#text then error("invalid V3 transport padding",0) end
        if c==61 and d~=61 then error("invalid V3 transport padding",0) end
        local n=x*262144+y*4096+(z or 0)*64+(w or 0)
        local bytes={string.char(math.floor(n/65536)%256)}
        if c~=61 then bytes[2]=string.char(math.floor(n/256)%256) end
        if d~=61 then bytes[3]=string.char(n%256) end
        result[#result+1]=table.concat(bytes)
    end
    return table.concat(result)
end

local bxor, band, rol = bit32.bxor, bit32.band, bit32.lrotate
local function uint32(s, p)
    local a,b,c,d=string.byte(s,p,p+3)
    if not d then error("invalid protected data",0) end
    return a+b*256+c*65536+d*16777216
end
local function bytes32(n)
    return string.char(n%256,math.floor(n/256)%256,math.floor(n/65536)%256,math.floor(n/16777216)%256)
end
local function crypt(data,key,nonce)
    local initial={1634760805,857760878,2036477234,1797285236}
    for i=1,8 do initial[i+4]=uint32(key,(i-1)*4+1) end
    initial[13]=1
    for i=1,3 do initial[i+13]=uint32(nonce,(i-1)*4+1) end
    local out={}
    local x
    local function quarter(a,b,c,d)
        x[a]=(x[a]+x[b])%4294967296; x[d]=rol(bxor(x[d],x[a]),16)
        x[c]=(x[c]+x[d])%4294967296; x[b]=rol(bxor(x[b],x[c]),12)
        x[a]=(x[a]+x[b])%4294967296; x[d]=rol(bxor(x[d],x[a]),8)
        x[c]=(x[c]+x[d])%4294967296; x[b]=rol(bxor(x[b],x[c]),7)
    end
    for offset=1,#data,64 do
        x=table.clone(initial)
        for _=1,10 do
            quarter(1,5,9,13);quarter(2,6,10,14);quarter(3,7,11,15);quarter(4,8,12,16)
            quarter(1,6,11,16);quarter(2,7,12,13);quarter(3,8,9,14);quarter(4,5,10,15)
        end
        local block={};for i=1,16 do block[i]=bytes32((x[i]+initial[i])%4294967296) end
        local stream=table.concat(block);local chunk={}
        for i=0,math.min(63,#data-offset) do chunk[i+1]=string.char(bxor(string.byte(data,offset+i),string.byte(stream,i+1))) end
        out[#out+1]=table.concat(chunk);initial[13]=(initial[13]+1)%4294967296
        if initial[13]==0 then error("protected data too large",0) end
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end
local function decode(s)
    local pos,budget=1,0
    local function uint()
        local n,m=0,1
        for _=1,5 do
            local b=string.byte(s,pos);pos+=1
            if not b then error("truncated protected data",0) end
            n+=(b%128)*m
            if b<128 then return n end
            m*=128
        end
        error("invalid protected length",0)
    end
    local read
    read=function(depth)
        budget+=1;if depth>256 or budget>4000000 then error("protected format limit",0) end
        local tag=string.byte(s,pos);pos+=1
        if tag==0 then return nil elseif tag==1 then return false elseif tag==2 then return true
        elseif tag==6 then return uint()
        elseif tag==3 then
            local lo,hi=uint32(s,pos),uint32(s,pos+4);pos+=8
            local sign=hi>=2147483648 and -1 or 1
            local exponent=math.floor(hi/1048576)%2048
            local mantissa=(hi%1048576)*4294967296+lo
            if exponent==0 then return sign*mantissa*2^-1074 end
            if exponent==2047 then return mantissa==0 and sign*math.huge or 0/0 end
            return sign*(1+mantissa/4503599627370496)*2^(exponent-1023)
        elseif tag==4 then
            local n=uint();if n>#s-pos+1 then error("truncated protected string",0) end
            local value=string.sub(s,pos,pos+n-1);pos+=n;return value
        elseif tag==5 then
            local n=uint();if n>4000000 or n>#s-pos+1 then error("invalid protected array",0) end
            local result={};for i=1,n do result[i]=read(depth+1) end;return result
        end
        error("invalid protected value",0)
    end
    local result=read(0)
    if pos~=#s+1 then error("extra protected data",0) end
    return result
end

local function __uzp_hex(value,label)
 if type(value)~="string" or #value~=64 or value:find("[^%x]") then error(label,0) end
 return (value:gsub("%x%x",function(h)return string.char(tonumber(h,16))end))
end
local function __uzp_catalog_key()
 if type(__uzp_entry)~="table" then error("Protected catalog key unavailable",0) end
 return __uzp_hex(__uzp_entry.catalog,"Protected catalog key unavailable")
end
local function __uzp_proto_key(proto)
 local keys=type(__uzp_entry)=="table" and __uzp_entry.keys or nil
 local value=type(keys)=="table" and (keys[proto] or keys[tostring(proto)]) or nil
 if not value and __uzp_unlock then value=__uzp_unlock(proto) end
 return __uzp_hex(value,"Protected prototype key unavailable")
end

    end

local __rsa=(function()
-- Pure-Luau RSA-2048 PKCS#1 v1.5 SHA-256 verification (bit32 only).
local bit32 = bit32
local band, bor, bxor, rshift, lshift = bit32.band, bit32.bor, bit32.bxor, bit32.rshift, bit32.lshift
local B = 16777216 -- 2^24

local function sha256(message)
    local K = {
        0x428a2f98,0x71374491,0xb5c0fbcf,0xe9b5dba5,0x3956c25b,0x59f111f1,0x923f82a4,0xab1c5ed5,

        0x983e5152,0xa831c66d,0xb00327c8,0xbf597fc7,0xc6e00bf3,0xd5a79147,0x06ca6351,0x14292967,
        0x27b70a85,0x2e1b2138,0x4d2c6dfc,0x53380d13,0x650a7354,0x766a0abb,0x81c2c92e,0x92722c85,
        0xa2bfe8a1,0xa81a664b,0xc24b8b70,0xc76c51a3,0xd192e819,0xd6990624,0xf40e3585,0x106aa070,
        0x19a4c116,0x1e376c08,0x2748774c,0x34b0bcb5,0x391c0cb3,0x4ed8aa4a,0x5b9cca4f,0x682e6ff3,
        0x748f82ee,0x78a5636f,0x84c87814,0x8cc70208,0x90befffa,0xa4506ceb,0xbef9a3f7,0xc67178f2,
    }
    local h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7 = 0x6a09e667,0xbb67ae85,0x3c6ef372,0xa54ff53a,0x510e527f,0x9b05688c,0x1f83d9ab,0x5be0cd19
    local function ror(x,n) return bor(rshift(x,n), lshift(x, 32-n)) end
    local bytes = { string.byte(message,1,#message) }
    local bitLength = #message * 8
    bytes[#bytes+1] = 0x80
    while #bytes % 64 ~= 56 do bytes[#bytes+1] = 0 end
    local high = math.floor(bitLength / 4294967296)
    for i = 3, 0, -1 do bytes[#bytes+1] = math.floor(high / 256^i) % 256 end
    for i = 3, 0, -1 do bytes[#bytes+1] = math.floor(bitLength / 256^i) % 256 end
    for chunk = 1, #bytes, 64 do
        local w = {}
        for i = 0, 15 do
            local o = chunk + i * 4
            w[i] = bytes[o]*16777216 + bytes[o+1]*65536 + bytes[o+2]*256 + bytes[o+3]
        end
        for i = 16, 63 do
            local s0 = bxor(ror(w[i-15],7), ror(w[i-15],18), rshift(w[i-15],3))
            local s1 = bxor(ror(w[i-2],17), ror(w[i-2],19), rshift(w[i-2],10))
            w[i] = (w[i-16] + s0 + w[i-7] + s1) % 4294967296
        end
        local a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h = h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7
        for i = 0, 63 do
            local S1 = bxor(ror(e,6), ror(e,11), ror(e,25))
            local ch = bxor(band(e,f), band(bxor(e,0xffffffff),g))
            local t1 = (h + S1 + ch + K[i+1] + w[i]) % 4294967296
            local S0 = bxor(ror(a,2), ror(a,13), ror(a,22))
            local maj = bxor(band(a,b), band(a,c), band(b,c))
            local t2 = (S0 + maj) % 4294967296
            h,g,f,e,d,c,b,a = g,f,e,(d+t1)%4294967296,c,b,a,(t1+t2)%4294967296
        end
        h0=(h0+a)%4294967296; h1=(h1+b)%4294967296; h2=(h2+c)%4294967296; h3=(h3+d)%4294967296
        h4=(h4+e)%4294967296; h5=(h5+f)%4294967296; h6=(h6+g)%4294967296; h7=(h7+h)%4294967296
    end

    end
    return table.concat(out)

local function fromBytes(s)
    local limbs, value, shift = {}, 0, 1
    for i = #s, 1, -1 do
        value = value + string.byte(s,i) * shift
        shift = shift * 256
        if shift == B then limbs[#limbs+1] = value; value, shift = 0, 1 end
    end
    if shift > 1 then limbs[#limbs+1] = value end
    while #limbs > 0 and limbs[#limbs] == 0 do limbs[#limbs] = nil end
    return limbs
end

local function toBytes(limbs, length)
    local out = {}
    local count = math.ceil(length / 3)
    for i = 1, count do
        local v = limbs[i] or 0
        out[#out+1] = v % 256
        out[#out+1] = math.floor(v / 256) % 256
        out[#out+1] = math.floor(v / 65536) % 256
    end
    local bytes = {}
    for i = length, 1, -1 do bytes[#bytes+1] = string.char(out[i]) end
    return table.concat(bytes)
end

local function compare(a,b)
    local n = math.max(#a,#b)
    for i = n, 1, -1 do
        local x,y = a[i] or 0, b[i] or 0
        if x ~= y then return x < y and -1 or 1 end
    end
    return 0
end

local function subtract(a,b)
    local out, borrow = {}, 0
    for i = 1, #a do
        local v = (a[i] or 0) - (b[i] or 0) - borrow
        if v < 0 then v = v + B; borrow = 1 else borrow = 0 end
        out[i] = v
    end
    while #out > 0 and out[#out] == 0 do out[#out] = nil end
    return out
end

local function montMul(a,b,n,n0inv,L)
    local t = {}
    for i = 1, 2*L + 1 do t[i] = 0 end
    for i = 1, L do
        local ai = a[i] or 0
        local carry = 0
        for j = 1, L do
            local k = i + j - 1
            local v = t[k] + ai * (b[j] or 0) + carry
            t[k] = v % B
            carry = math.floor(v / B)
        end
        local k = i + L
        while carry > 0 do
            local v = t[k] + carry
            t[k] = v % B
            carry = math.floor(v / B)
            k = k + 1
        end
    end
    for i = 1, L do
        local m = (t[i] * n0inv) % B
        local carry = 0
        for j = 1, L do
            local k = i + j - 1
            local v = t[k] + m * (n[j] or 0) + carry
            t[k] = v % B
            carry = math.floor(v / B)
        end
        local k = i + L
        while carry > 0 do
            local v = t[k] + carry
            t[k] = v % B
            carry = math.floor(v / B)
            k = k + 1
        end
    end
    local r = {}
    for i = 1, L do r[i] = t[L+i] or 0 end
    if (t[2*L+1] or 0) > 0 then r[L+1] = t[2*L+1] end
    if compare(r,n) >= 0 then r = subtract(r,n) end
    while #r > 0 and r[#r] == 0 do r[#r] = nil end
    return r
end

local function powmod(sig, n, n0inv, R2, L)
    local one = {1}
    local base = montMul(sig, R2, n, n0inv, L)
    local r = base
    for _ = 1, 16 do r = montMul(r, r, n, n0inv, L) end
    r = montMul(r, base, n, n0inv, L)
    return montMul(r, one, n, n0inv, L)
end

local function verify(message, signature, n, n0inv, R2, L)
    local s = fromBytes(signature)
    if #s > L then return false end
    if compare(s, n) >= 0 then return false end
    local value = powmod(s, n, n0inv, R2, L)
    local em = toBytes(value, 256)
    local digest = sha256(message)
    local prefix = "\0\1" .. string.rep("\255", 202) .. "\0" .. "\48\49\48\13\6\9\96\134\72\1\101\3\4\2\1\5\0\4\32"
    return em == prefix .. digest
end

local function montOne(n,n0inv,R2,L) return montMul(R2,{1},n,n0inv,L) end

return { verify = verify, sha256 = sha256, powmod = powmod, toBytes = toBytes, fromBytes = fromBytes, montOne = montOne }

local function immutable(value)
    if type(value)~="table" or table.isfrozen(value) then return value end
    for _,child in pairs(value) do if type(child)=="table" then immutable(child) end end
    table.freeze(value)
    if not table.isfrozen(value) then error("invalid V3 antitamper freeze",0) end
    return value
end
local function checked(data,key,nonce,length,expected,raw)
    local plain=crypt(data,key,nonce)
    if #plain~=length then error("invalid V3 section length",0) end
    local a,b=1,0
    for i=1,#plain do a=(a+string.byte(plain,i))%65521;b=(b+a)%65521 end
    if b*65536+a~=expected then error("invalid V3 section checksum",0) end
    if raw then return plain end
    return decode(plain)
end

local function unbase64(text)
    if #text%4~=0 then error("invalid V3 transport length",0) end
    local result={}
    for i=1,#text,4 do
        local a,b,c,d=string.byte(text,i,i+3)
        local x,y,z,w=base64codes[a],base64codes[b],base64codes[c],base64codes[d]
        if not x or not y or (not z and c~=61) or (not w and d~=61) then error("invalid V3 transport",0) end
        if (c==61 or d==61) and i+3~=#text then error("invalid V3 transport padding",0) end
        if c==61 and d~=61 then error("invalid V3 transport padding",0) end
        local n=x*262144+y*4096+(z or 0)*64+(w or 0)
        local bytes={string.char(math.floor(n/65536)%256)}
        if c~=61 then bytes[2]=string.char(math.floor(n/256)%256) end
        if d~=61 then bytes[3]=string.char(n%256) end
        result[#result+1]=table.concat(bytes)
    end
    return table.concat(result)
end

local function zY(Bi,EKM,pi)
    if type(Bi)~="number" or Bi%1~=0 or Bi<EKM or Bi>pi then error("invalid V3 integer/reference",0) end
    return Bi
end

    end
    return EE
end

local function q(f)

        local Cri,mUi=zY(Xn[1],1,#j),zY(Xn[2],1,#j)
        if Cri+mUi-1>#j then error("invalid V3 section range",0) end
        local hhQ=unbase64(string.sub(j,Cri,Cri+mUi-1))

    end
    return St
end

local tvN={}

end

local bxor, band, rol = bit32.bxor, bit32.band, bit32.lrotate
local function uint32(s, p)
    local a,b,c,d=string.byte(s,p,p+3)
    if not d then error("invalid protected data",0) end
    return a+b*256+c*65536+d*16777216
end
local function bytes32(n)
    return string.char(n%256,math.floor(n/256)%256,math.floor(n/65536)%256,math.floor(n/16777216)%256)
end
local function crypt(data,key,nonce)
    local initial={1634760805,857760878,2036477234,1797285236}
    for i=1,8 do initial[i+4]=uint32(key,(i-1)*4+1) end
    initial[13]=1
    for i=1,3 do initial[i+13]=uint32(nonce,(i-1)*4+1) end
    local out={}
    local x
    local function quarter(a,b,c,d)
        x[a]=(x[a]+x[b])%4294967296; x[d]=rol(bxor(x[d],x[a]),16)
        x[c]=(x[c]+x[d])%4294967296; x[b]=rol(bxor(x[b],x[c]),12)
        x[a]=(x[a]+x[b])%4294967296; x[d]=rol(bxor(x[d],x[a]),8)
        x[c]=(x[c]+x[d])%4294967296; x[b]=rol(bxor(x[b],x[c]),7)
    end
    for offset=1,#data,64 do
        x=table.clone(initial)
        for _=1,10 do
            quarter(1,5,9,13);quarter(2,6,10,14);quarter(3,7,11,15);quarter(4,8,12,16)
            quarter(1,6,11,16);quarter(2,7,12,13);quarter(3,8,9,14);quarter(4,5,10,15)
        end
        local block={};for i=1,16 do block[i]=bytes32((x[i]+initial[i])%4294967296) end
        local stream=table.concat(block);local chunk={}
        for i=0,math.min(63,#data-offset) do chunk[i+1]=string.char(bxor(string.byte(data,offset+i),string.byte(stream,i+1))) end
        out[#out+1]=table.concat(chunk);initial[13]=(initial[13]+1)%4294967296
        if initial[13]==0 then error("protected data too large",0) end
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end
local function decode(s)
    local pos,budget=1,0
    local function uint()
        local n,m=0,1
        for _=1,5 do
            local b=string.byte(s,pos);pos+=1
            if not b then error("truncated protected data",0) end
            n+=(b%128)*m
            if b<128 then return n end
            m*=128
        end
        error("invalid protected length",0)
    end
    local read
    read=function(depth)
        budget+=1;if depth>256 or budget>4000000 then error("protected format limit",0) end
        local tag=string.byte(s,pos);pos+=1
        if tag==0 then return nil elseif tag==1 then return false elseif tag==2 then return true
        elseif tag==6 then return uint()
        elseif tag==3 then
            local lo,hi=uint32(s,pos),uint32(s,pos+4);pos+=8
            local sign=hi>=2147483648 and -1 or 1
            local exponent=math.floor(hi/1048576)%2048
            local mantissa=(hi%1048576)*4294967296+lo
            if exponent==0 then return sign*mantissa*2^-1074 end
            if exponent==2047 then return mantissa==0 and sign*math.huge or 0/0 end
            return sign*(1+mantissa/4503599627370496)*2^(exponent-1023)
        elseif tag==4 then
            local n=uint();if n>#s-pos+1 then error("truncated protected string",0) end
            local value=string.sub(s,pos,pos+n-1);pos+=n;return value
        elseif tag==5 then
            local n=uint();if n>4000000 or n>#s-pos+1 then error("invalid protected array",0) end
            local result={};for i=1,n do result[i]=read(depth+1) end;return result
        end
        error("invalid protected value",0)
    end
    local result=read(0)
    if pos~=#s+1 then error("extra protected data",0) end
    return result
end

local function __uzp_hex(value,label)
 if type(value)~="string" or #value~=64 or value:find("[^%x]") then error(label,0) end
 return (value:gsub("%x%x",function(h)return string.char(tonumber(h,16))end))
end
local function __uzp_catalog_key()
 if type(__uzp_entry)~="table" then error("Protected catalog key unavailable",0) end
 return __uzp_hex(__uzp_entry.catalog,"Protected catalog key unavailable")
end
local function __uzp_proto_key(proto)
 local keys=type(__uzp_entry)=="table" and __uzp_entry.keys or nil
 local value=type(keys)=="table" and (keys[proto] or keys[tostring(proto)]) or nil
 if not value and __uzp_unlock then value=__uzp_unlock(proto) end
 return __uzp_hex(value,"Protected prototype key unavailable")
end

local __rsa=(function()
-- Pure-Luau RSA-2048 PKCS#1 v1.5 SHA-256 verification (bit32 only).
local bit32 = bit32
local band, bor, bxor, rshift, lshift = bit32.band, bit32.bor, bit32.bxor, bit32.rshift, bit32.lshift
local B = 16777216 -- 2^24

local function sha256(message)
    local K = {
        0x428a2f98,0x71374491,0xb5c0fbcf,0xe9b5dba5,0x3956c25b,0x59f111f1,0x923f82a4,0xab1c5ed5,

        0x983e5152,0xa831c66d,0xb00327c8,0xbf597fc7,0xc6e00bf3,0xd5a79147,0x06ca6351,0x14292967,

        0x19a4c116,0x1e376c08,0x2748774c,0x34b0bcb5,0x391c0cb3,0x4ed8aa4a,0x5b9cca4f,0x682e6ff3,
        0x748f82ee,0x78a5636f,0x84c87814,0x8cc70208,0x90befffa,0xa4506ceb,0xbef9a3f7,0xc67178f2,
    }
    local h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7 = 0x6a09e667,0xbb67ae85,0x3c6ef372,0xa54ff53a,0x510e527f,0x9b05688c,0x1f83d9ab,0x5be0cd19
    local function ror(x,n) return bor(rshift(x,n), lshift(x, 32-n)) end
    local bytes = { string.byte(message,1,#message) }
    local bitLength = #message * 8
    bytes[#bytes+1] = 0x80
    while #bytes % 64 ~= 56 do bytes[#bytes+1] = 0 end
    local high = math.floor(bitLength / 4294967296)
    for i = 3, 0, -1 do bytes[#bytes+1] = math.floor(high / 256^i) % 256 end
    for i = 3, 0, -1 do bytes[#bytes+1] = math.floor(bitLength / 256^i) % 256 end
    for chunk = 1, #bytes, 64 do
        local w = {}
        for i = 0, 15 do
            local o = chunk + i * 4
            w[i] = bytes[o]*16777216 + bytes[o+1]*65536 + bytes[o+2]*256 + bytes[o+3]
        end
        for i = 16, 63 do
            local s0 = bxor(ror(w[i-15],7), ror(w[i-15],18), rshift(w[i-15],3))
            local s1 = bxor(ror(w[i-2],17), ror(w[i-2],19), rshift(w[i-2],10))
            w[i] = (w[i-16] + s0 + w[i-7] + s1) % 4294967296
        end
        local a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h = h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7
        for i = 0, 63 do

            local ch = bxor(band(e,f), band(bxor(e,0xffffffff),g))
            local t1 = (h + S1 + ch + K[i+1] + w[i]) % 4294967296
            local S0 = bxor(ror(a,2), ror(a,13), ror(a,22))
            local maj = bxor(band(a,b), band(a,c), band(b,c))
            local t2 = (S0 + maj) % 4294967296
            h,g,f,e,d,c,b,a = g,f,e,(d+t1)%4294967296,c,b,a,(t1+t2)%4294967296
        end

local function fromBytes(s)
    local limbs, value, shift = {}, 0, 1
    for i = #s, 1, -1 do
        value = value + string.byte(s,i) * shift
        shift = shift * 256
        if shift == B then limbs[#limbs+1] = value; value, shift = 0, 1 end
    end
    if shift > 1 then limbs[#limbs+1] = value end
    while #limbs > 0 and limbs[#limbs] == 0 do limbs[#limbs] = nil end
    return limbs
end

local function toBytes(limbs, length)
    local out = {}
    local count = math.ceil(length / 3)
    for i = 1, count do
        local v = limbs[i] or 0
        out[#out+1] = v % 256
        out[#out+1] = math.floor(v / 256) % 256
        out[#out+1] = math.floor(v / 65536) % 256
    end
    local bytes = {}
    for i = length, 1, -1 do bytes[#bytes+1] = string.char(out[i]) end
    return table.concat(bytes)
end

local function compare(a,b)
    local n = math.max(#a,#b)
    for i = n, 1, -1 do
        local x,y = a[i] or 0, b[i] or 0
        if x ~= y then return x < y and -1 or 1 end
    end
    return 0
end

local function subtract(a,b)
    local out, borrow = {}, 0
    for i = 1, #a do
        local v = (a[i] or 0) - (b[i] or 0) - borrow
        if v < 0 then v = v + B; borrow = 1 else borrow = 0 end
        out[i] = v
    end
    while #out > 0 and out[#out] == 0 do out[#out] = nil end
    return out
end

local function montMul(a,b,n,n0inv,L)
    local t = {}
    for i = 1, 2*L + 1 do t[i] = 0 end
    for i = 1, L do
        local ai = a[i] or 0
        local carry = 0
        for j = 1, L do
            local k = i + j - 1
            local v = t[k] + ai * (b[j] or 0) + carry
            t[k] = v % B
            carry = math.floor(v / B)
        end
        local k = i + L
        while carry > 0 do
            local v = t[k] + carry
            t[k] = v % B
            carry = math.floor(v / B)
            k = k + 1
        end
    end
    for i = 1, L do
        local m = (t[i] * n0inv) % B
        local carry = 0
        for j = 1, L do
            local k = i + j - 1
            local v = t[k] + m * (n[j] or 0) + carry
            t[k] = v % B
            carry = math.floor(v / B)
        end
        local k = i + L
        while carry > 0 do
            local v = t[k] + carry
            t[k] = v % B
            carry = math.floor(v / B)
            k = k + 1
        end
    end
    local r = {}
    for i = 1, L do r[i] = t[L+i] or 0 end
    if (t[2*L+1] or 0) > 0 then r[L+1] = t[2*L+1] end
    if compare(r,n) >= 0 then r = subtract(r,n) end
    while #r > 0 and r[#r] == 0 do r[#r] = nil end
    return r
end

local function powmod(sig, n, n0inv, R2, L)
    local one = {1}
    local base = montMul(sig, R2, n, n0inv, L)
    local r = base
    for _ = 1, 16 do r = montMul(r, r, n, n0inv, L) end
    r = montMul(r, base, n, n0inv, L)
    return montMul(r, one, n, n0inv, L)
end

local function verify(message, signature, n, n0inv, R2, L)
    local s = fromBytes(signature)
    if #s > L then return false end
    if compare(s, n) >= 0 then return false end
    local value = powmod(s, n, n0inv, R2, L)
    local em = toBytes(value, 256)
    local digest = sha256(message)
    local prefix = "\0\1" .. string.rep("\255", 202) .. "\0" .. "\48\49\48\13\6\9\96\134\72\1\101\3\4\2\1\5\0\4\32"
    return em == prefix .. digest
end

local function montOne(n,n0inv,R2,L) return montMul(R2,{1},n,n0inv,L) end

return { verify = verify, sha256 = sha256, powmod = powmod, toBytes = toBytes, fromBytes = fromBytes, montOne = montOne }

local function immutable(value)
    if type(value)~="table" or table.isfrozen(value) then return value end
    for _,child in pairs(value) do if type(child)=="table" then immutable(child) end end
    table.freeze(value)
    if not table.isfrozen(value) then error("invalid V3 antitamper freeze",0) end
    return value
end
local function checked(data,key,nonce,length,expected,raw)
    local plain=crypt(data,key,nonce)
    if #plain~=length then error("invalid V3 section length",0) end
    local a,b=1,0
    for i=1,#plain do a=(a+string.byte(plain,i))%65521;b=(b+a)%65521 end
    if b*65536+a~=expected then error("invalid V3 section checksum",0) end
    if raw then return plain end
    return decode(plain)
end

local function unbase64(text)
    if #text%4~=0 then error("invalid V3 transport length",0) end
    local result={}
    for i=1,#text,4 do
        local a,b,c,d=string.byte(text,i,i+3)
        local x,y,z,w=base64codes[a],base64codes[b],base64codes[c],base64codes[d]
        if not x or not y or (not z and c~=61) or (not w and d~=61) then error("invalid V3 transport",0) end
        if (c==61 or d==61) and i+3~=#text then error("invalid V3 transport padding",0) end
        if c==61 and d~=61 then error("invalid V3 transport padding",0) end
        local n=x*262144+y*4096+(z or 0)*64+(w or 0)
        local bytes={string.char(math.floor(n/65536)%256)}
        if c~=61 then bytes[2]=string.char(math.floor(n/256)%256) end
        if d~=61 then bytes[3]=string.char(n%256) end
        result[#result+1]=table.concat(bytes)
    end
    return table.concat(result)
end

    if type(Vys)~="number" or Vys%1~=0 or Vys<ng or Vys>U then error("invalid V3 integer/reference",0) end

end
